description: Known answers for the key check of CC 2.6.1.8 step 8 (rc21: ways (a)-(d), an occurrence key's proof of possession signed as itself (90d537b), Waiting on what is not held, half-open coverage, at a row and at a rotation) and the end rule of step 4. Each case gives the directory: key records, admitted occurrences, evictions, the bundle in force's seats as [issuer seed, seated key seed], and a pending bundle. Keys are from seeds: ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 seed [n+100]*32.

cases.description: N rotates to M1 at T0+4999, the last instant N's record covers: M1 is N's key.
N rotates to M2 at exactly T0+5000, N's valid_until: the end is not covered, the rotation does not stand and N has no successor.
Z's only record states valid_until = asserted_at: the record is Invalid at step 4 (valid_until_not_after_asserted_at), so a row Z signs is under no valid key.
